name: DocsMint
author: HiAi-gg
description: Cloud or self-hosted knowledge for AI agents: hybrid search, reranking, GraphRAG, scoped MCP tools.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Hybrid search across documents (full-text + semantic). Supports filtering by folder and tags.

folder.description: Optional folder ID to scope the search to.

tags.description: Optional tag IDs to filter by.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 20).

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read one document with its content, metadata, and tags before editing or citing it. Requires read access. Use export_document when you only need portable Markdown.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new document. Optionally provide initial markdown content and a folder ID.

content.description: Initial markdown content for the document.

folderId.description: Optional folder ID to place the document in.

categoryId.description: Optional category ID. Category keys are always rebound to their configured category.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Update an existing document's title and/or content. The server creates a new version on each update.

content.description: New markdown content for the document.

folderId.description: Move the document to a folder.

categoryId.description: Move the document to a category. Category keys cannot escape their configured category.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents with pagination, optionally filtered by folder or tag.

folderId.description: Optional folder ID to filter by.

tag.description: Optional tag ID to filter by.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List folders, optionally scoped to a parent folder. Returns a flat list of immediate children.

parentId.description: Optional parent folder ID. Omit to list top-level (root) folders.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder, optionally nested under a parent folder.

parentId.description: Optional parent folder ID for nesting.

categoryId.description: Optional category ID. Category keys are always rebound to their configured category.

tools.name: create_snapshot
tools.description: Create a named snapshot (labelled version) of a document from its current content.

description.description: Optional longer description of the snapshot.

tools.name: get_version_history
tools.description: List the version history for a document. Optionally restrict to named snapshots.

documentId.description: Document ID whose versions should be listed.

onlySnapshots.description: When true, only return named snapshots (skip auto-saved revisions).

tools.name: export_document
tools.description: Render one readable document as portable Markdown and return a markdown string in the response object. Does not modify the document or include its complete metadata; use get_document to inspect the editable document.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List categories visible to the API key. Category keys receive only their bound category.

tools.name: create_category
tools.description: Create a category. Requires a workspace key with write access; category keys cannot mutate categories.

name.description: Non-empty display name for the new category, for example Project notes.

description.description: Optional plain-text explanation of the category purpose; omit if not needed.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List tags visible in the workspace or bound category.

tools.name: get_related_documents
tools.description: Find graph-related documents from one readable document, without a text query. Returns related documents and relation metadata. Use search_knowledge_graph to filter graph neighbors by text, or search_documents for normal retrieval. Results stay within the active scope and may be empty when graph data is unavailable.

documentId.description: Document UUID returned by search_documents or list_documents; must be readable in the active scope.

limit.description: Maximum related documents to return, from 1 to 50. Omit to use the server default.

tools.name: search_knowledge_graph
tools.description: Retrieve graph context from one or more readable seed documents and filter/rank related documents by query text. Returns seed entities and relatedDocs; use search_documents first to obtain seed IDs. Returned documents stay within the active category. Graph data may be empty when unavailable.

query.description: Search text used to filter and rank graph-related documents. Preserve the original query language.

docIds.description: Between 1 and 50 authorized document UUIDs from search_documents or list_documents to use as graph traversal seeds.

limit.description: Maximum related documents to return, from 1 to 50. Omit to use the server default.

tools.name: get_document_index_status
tools.description: Read a document indexing and knowledge-pipeline status without starting any work. Use after a save or refresh_document_index to inspect progress and failures. Requires read access to the document.

documentId.description: Document UUID returned by search_documents or list_documents; must be readable in the active scope.

tools.name: refresh_document_index
tools.description: Queue document reindexing and return the server acknowledgment; processing completes asynchronously. Requires write access. Normal saves already schedule indexing; use this for an explicit refresh and inspect progress with get_document_index_status.

documentId.description: Document UUID returned by search_documents or list_documents; must be readable in the active scope.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Move a document to trash. Requires write access to the document; category keys are limited to their category. Does not permanently purge content. Returns the document ID and deleted=true. Use only when the user intends deletion.

id.description: UUID of the document to move to trash; obtain it from search_documents, list_documents, or get_document.

tools.name: delete_folder
tools.description: Delete a folder while preserving its documents. Direct child folders and documents are detached according to the server folder rules, and reindexing is queued for affected documents. Requires write access in the permitted workspace or category. Returns the folder ID and deleted=true.

id.description: UUID of the folder to delete; obtain it from list_folders. This does not delete the documents inside it.

tools.name: delete_category
tools.description: Delete a category and detach its folders and documents without deleting their content. Requires full workspace write access; category-scoped keys cannot delete any category, including their own. Returns the category ID and deleted=true.

id.description: UUID of the category to delete; obtain it from list_categories using a workspace key.

tools.name: restore_document_version
tools.description: Restore document content from a version or named snapshot returned by get_version_history. Requires edit access to that document. The server backs up the current content, records the restoration, and queues document reindexing. Returns the updated document. Does not restore a document from trash or restore folder/category placement.

documentId.description: UUID of the document whose content should be restored; it must be visible in the active workspace or category.

versionId.description: UUID of a version belonging to this document, from get_version_history. Use the version ID, not a snapshot label.

prompts.name: organize_workspace
prompts.description: Plan safe document organization using DocsMint categories and folders.

prompts.name: research_workspace
prompts.description: Research a question with hybrid search and GraphRAG while citing DocsMint document IDs.

resources.name: editor-guide
resources.description: Editor usage guide: read before update, preserve language and structure, refresh the index when needed.

resources.name: search-guide
resources.description: Search and GraphRAG guide: hybrid retrieval first, graph only from authorized document IDs.

resources.name: workspace-catalog
resources.description: Live scoped workspace catalog of categories, folders, and tags visible to the API key.

localizations.name: DocsMint
localizations.description: Cloud or self-hosted knowledge for AI agents: hybrid search, reranking, GraphRAG, scoped MCP tools.
localizations.summary:
Search, read, create, and organize the same documents you use in DocsMint. Choose DocsMint Cloud for the simplest connection, or connect a self-hosted workspace with the stdio bridge.

## DocsMint Cloud — recommended

1. Open [DocsMint Cloud setup](https://docsmint.com/mcp/connect?source=lobehub_mcp).
2. Connect to `https://docsmint.com/mcp` over Streamable HTTP; no server deployment or local process is required.
3. OAuth clients discover hosted authorization. Current metadata advertises the code response, authorization_code grant, no token-endpoint client authentication, PKCE S256, and DCR at `https://docsmint.com/oauth/register`; CIMD is not part of the current contract. Consent binds one-hour access tokens to a workspace, optional category, and scopes. Refresh tokens are not issued.
4. Clients using API keys can send `Authorization: Bearer <key>` with a workspace-bound or category-scoped credential created in the authenticated browser UI.

## Self-hosted — advanced

1. [Install DocsMint with Docker](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint#quickstart).
2. Create an API key in your DocsMint browser UI.
3. Set `HIAI_DOCS_URL` and `HIAI_DOCS_API_KEY` in your MCP client's environment, then run the stdio bridge:

```sh
bunx --package @hiai-gg/docsmint@0.8.8 docsmint-mcp
```

The npm package connects to your existing DocsMint API with your API key; it does not install the application, database, or hosted Cloud OAuth server.

[Client configuration](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/packages/mcp-server/README.md) · [Docker images](https://hub.docker.com/r/vgalibov/docsmint) · [Deployment guide](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)

## What your agent can do

- Search documents with hybrid retrieval and GraphRAG.
- Read, create, update, and organize documents within the granted scope.
- Browse folders, tags, version history, and indexing status.

## Latest release: 0.8.8

Clarifies the DocsMint Cloud authorization contract and the self-hosted API-key bridge. Registry metadata matches the 21-tool, 2-prompt, 3-resource catalog. No database migration or capability change is required.

[Release notes](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/releases/tag/v0.8.8) · [Current README](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint#readme) · [Full changelog](https://github.com/HiAi-gg/docsmint/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
